description: Commit 25 — Admin overview enhanced with Recharts time-series charts. Installs recharts, adds a TimeSeries API call to adminApi, adds two Recharts charts (daily requests+donations area chart, blood group bar chart) to admin/page.tsx via a client wrapper component. The existing 4-stat cards and requests-by-status table in admin/page.tsx must be preserved exactly.
steps: 1. Install recharts: run `npm install recharts@^2.15.0` inside /Users/raheelarfeen/Programming-Hero_lvl_2/Assignment_6+7/RaktoSheba-Frontend. Also run `npm install --save-dev @types/recharts` if it exists on npm, otherwise skip (recharts ships its own types). After install, confirm `node_modules/recharts` exists.

2. Extend src/lib/admin.ts: add a `timeSeries` method to `adminApi`. Import `TimeSeries` from `@/types`. The new method: `timeSeries: (token: string, days = 30) => api<TimeSeries>('/admin/analytics/time-series', { token, cache: 'no-store', query: { days } })`. The existing `analytics` method must remain unchanged.

3. Extend src/components/dashboard/nav-config.ts: add four new items to the ADMIN array (after the existing Overview item): `{ href: '/dashboard/admin/queue', label: 'Verification queue', icon: ClipboardCheck }`, `{ href: '/dashboard/admin/hospitals', label: 'Hospitals', icon: Building2 }`, `{ href: '/dashboard/admin/users', label: 'Users', icon: Users }`, `{ href: '/dashboard/admin/payments', label: 'Payments & audit', icon: CreditCard }`. Add `ClipboardCheck, Building2, Users, CreditCard` to the lucide-react import. (Building2 and Users are already imported — do not duplicate; add only the missing ones.)

4. Create src/app/dashboard/admin/components/admin-charts.tsx as a `'use client'` component. Props: `timeSeries: TimeSeries`. Import from recharts: `ResponsiveContainer, AreaChart, Area, BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip`. Render two sections: (a) `<section aria-labelledby='daily-chart-heading'>` — heading 'Last 30 days', `<ResponsiveContainer width='100%' height={220}>` wrapping an `<AreaChart data={timeSeries.daily}>`. Two `<Area>` traces: `dataKey='requests'` with stroke `#A92836` fill `#A92836` fillOpacity 0.12, and `dataKey='donations'` with stroke `#2D7A5F` fill `#2D7A5F` fillOpacity 0.12. `<XAxis dataKey='date' tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} tickFormatter={(d) => new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' })} />`, `<YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} width={28} allowDecimals={false} />`, `<CartesianGrid strokeDasharray='3 3' stroke='rgba(62,41,36,.08)' />`, `<Tooltip contentStyle={{ borderRadius: '14px', border: '1px solid rgba(62,41,36,.1)', background: '#fdfaf7', fontSize: 12 }} />`. (b) `<section aria-labelledby='blood-chart-heading'>` — heading 'Open requests by blood group', `<ResponsiveContainer width='100%' height={200}>` wrapping a `<BarChart data={timeSeries.byBloodGroup}>`. Single `<Bar dataKey='open' fill='#A92836' radius={[6,6,0,0]} />`, `<XAxis dataKey='bloodGroup' tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} tickFormatter={(g: string) => g.replace('_POSITIVE','+').replace('_NEGATIVE','−')} />`, `<YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} width={28} allowDecimals={false} />`, `<CartesianGrid strokeDasharray='3 3' stroke='rgba(62,41,36,.08)' />`. Wrap both sections in a `<div className='grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2'>` inside a single `<div className='rounded-[24px] border border-ink/10 bg-cream p-6 space-y-6'>`. Export as `AdminCharts`.

5. Edit src/app/dashboard/admin/page.tsx: add a `timeSeries` call alongside the existing `analytics` call: `const [a, ts] = await Promise.all([adminApi.analytics(session.accessToken), adminApi.timeSeries(session.accessToken)])`. Import `AdminCharts` from `./components/admin-charts`. Add `<AdminCharts timeSeries={ts} />` after the existing requests-by-status card. Do NOT change any of the existing stat cards, heading, or requests-by-status section.

6. Update src/app/dashboard/admin/loading.tsx: add a chart skeleton section after the existing 5-column skeleton grid. The chart skeleton is a `
`.

7. Commit: `git add package.json package-lock.json src/lib/admin.ts src/components/dashboard/nav-config.ts src/app/dashboard/admin/components/admin-charts.tsx src/app/dashboard/admin/page.tsx src/app/dashboard/admin/loading.tsx && git commit -m 'feat: add admin overview with charts'`
